import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 3, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 24
NBLK = 3


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))

        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(NBLK)])
        self.ctx = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, WIDTH) for _ in range(NBLK)])
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

        for conv, ctx in zip(self.blocks, self.ctx):

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

W = 24
PROJ = 16
HID = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = 12 + 3 + 1
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(cin, W, 1)
        self.col = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        Z = self.Z
        occ = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        occ = F.pad(occ, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        nb = torch.cat([occ[:, :, 0:Z], occ[:, :, 1:Z + 1], occ[:, :, 2:Z + 2]], dim=1)
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(2).expand(B, 3, Z, Y, X)
        zp = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([nb, gl, zp], dim=1).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * Z, 16, Y, X)

        h0 = F.relu(self.inp(x))
        hv = h0.view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        c = self.col(hv.amax(1))
        h = F.relu(hv + c.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(h + self.conv(h))

        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            t = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(t))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1).reshape(B, Z, -1)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1)

        hv2 = h.view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([hv2.mean((1, 3, 4)), hv2.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 3, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
HEADS = 4


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Attn(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = heads
        self.dh = c // heads
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(c)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(c, 3 * self.h * self.dh)
        self.out = nn.Linear(self.h * self.dh, c)

    def forward(self, f):
        B, C, Y, X = f.shape
        t = f.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        n = self.norm(t)
        qkv = self.qkv(n).reshape(B, Y * X, 3, self.h, self.dh).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q = qkv[0]
        k = qkv[1]
        v = qkv[2]
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(self.dh), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(a, v).permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(B, Y * X, self.h * self.dh)
        t = t + self.out(o)
        return t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, C, Y, X)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.T = int(spec.n_types)
        self.np = int(spec.n_place)
        cin = spec.in_channels + self.T + 2
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.attn = Attn(WIDTH, HEADS)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        m = mask[:, :self.np].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.T, Y, X)
        yy = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Y, 1).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        xx = torch.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, 1, X).expand(B, 1, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m, yy, xx], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        f = self.attn(f)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 3, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 48
WIDTH = 40
NBLK = 3
KL = 8
KS = 8
HID = 24


class LayerHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, Z, footprints, k, s, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(Z)
        self.k = k
        self.s = s
        self.hid = hid
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, self.Z * k + s, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * (k + s), hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.zemb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(len(self.fps), self.Z, hid))
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def split(self, t):
        B = t.shape[0]
        Y = t.shape[2]
        X = t.shape[3]
        Z = self.Z
        lay = t[:, :Z * self.k].reshape(B, Z, self.k, Y, X)
        sh = t[:, Z * self.k:].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, self.s, Y, X)
        return torch.cat([lay, sh], dim=2)

    def forward(self, f):
        B = f.shape[0]
        Y = f.shape[2]
        X = f.shape[3]
        Z = self.Z
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for i, ((dy, dx), mix, out) in enumerate(zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs)):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            u = torch.cat([self.split(mx), self.split(mn), self.split(av)], dim=2)
            u = u.reshape(B * Z, 3 * (self.k + self.s), Y, X)
            h = mix(u).reshape(B, Z, self.hid, Y, X) + self.zemb[i][None, :, :, None, None]
            h = F.relu(h).reshape(B * Z, self.hid, Y, X)
            o = out(h).reshape(B, Z, Y, X)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(o, dim=1))
        return torch.stack(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(NBLK)])
        self.ctx = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, WIDTH) for _ in range(NBLK)])
        self.head = LayerHead(WIDTH, spec.Z, spec.footprints, KL, KS, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        f = self.stem(obs)
        for conv, ctx in zip(self.blocks, self.ctx):
            g = ctx(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
            f = F.relu(f + conv(f) + g[:, :, None, None])
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 3, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01}

W = 24
PROJ = 12
HID = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = 12 + 3 + 1
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(cin, W, 1)
        self.col = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctx = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = obs.shape[2]
        X = obs.shape[3]
        Z = self.Z
        occ = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        occ = F.pad(occ, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1))
        nb = torch.cat([occ[:, :, 0:Z], occ[:, :, 1:Z + 1], occ[:, :, 2:Z + 2]], dim=1)
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(2).expand(B, 3, Z, Y, X)
        zp = torch.linspace(0.0, 1.0, Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, 1, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, 1, Z, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([nb, gl, zp], dim=1).permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4).reshape(B * Z, 16, Y, X)

        h0 = F.relu(self.inp(x))
        hv = h0.view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        c = self.col(hv.amax(1))
        h = F.relu(hv + c.unsqueeze(1)).reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(h + self.conv1(h))
        hv = h.view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        g = self.ctx(torch.cat([hv.mean((1, 3, 4)), hv.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1))
        h = (hv + g[:, None, :, None, None]).reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(h + self.conv2(h))

        p = self.proj(h)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            t = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(t))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1).reshape(B, Z, -1)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1)

        hv2 = h.view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        gg = self.glob(torch.cat([hv2.mean((1, 3, 4)), hv2.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(gg)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(gg).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: No results yet, and scores stay hidden for the whole search. I'll only see crashes and check failures, so each candidate should be a well-motivated, low-risk change, and the choice later on has to rest on reasoning. The budget is tight: with the default recipe the run gets about 131k samples, which is only 32 PPO updates. A network that costs less compute than the baseline gets no extra samples, and any growth in compute directly cuts the number of samples. Three directions: (1) recipe only, with more and smaller updates, fewer epochs (so more samples), and a longer horizon for the exact-build bonus; (2) the same compute spent on more depth plus a global-context broadcast, so each placement can use information from the whole board; (3) a layer-structured network. Placing the right brick depends on matching its landing layer to the target layer. Scoring each layer separately with shared weights, then a soft max over layers, puts that structure into the network without hand-computing any features.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials trained without errors, but no scores are shown, so I can't rank them or attribute any gain to a particular change. Since no result will tell us which change mattered, the useful goal is to raise the chance that at least one trial beats the baseline, rather than to isolate single changes. Reasoning from the task itself: the default recipe makes only about 32 updates, which is probably too few. A larger receptive field plus whole-board context should help with ordering (lower layers before bricks that rest on them, supports before overhangs) and with the DONE decision. The legal-action mask is free information about the height limit. So all three candidates use a recipe with more updates and a longer horizon (gamma 0.97, lambda 0.95), and they try different ways of getting global reasoning: pooled-context residual blocks, self-attention over cells, and a deeper, wider context net trained with fewer epochs to keep the sample count up.
analyses.3: Scores are hidden, so I can only reason from priors and design. All six trials trained without errors and stayed near 1–1.5x the starting compute, so there is room to try new structures. The main open question is a structural one. A placement is right when the brick lands at height z = max(height under footprint) and fills only missing target cells at that z. A 2D trunk mixes all layers into its channels, which makes per-layer matching hard to express. I am betting on three directions: (1) the strongest prior design, r2c1 (global-context residual net), with 2 PPO epochs so it gets more fresh samples; (2) a per-layer scoring head on the r2c1 trunk that scores each footprint at every layer and combines the layers with logsumexp; (3) a stronger version of r1c3's per-layer shared trunk, with a second conv, board context and the better recipe. With 2 seeds and no scores, mixing safe and structural bets keeps the selection robust.
analyses.4: All nine trials trained cleanly, but scores are hidden, so I can't tell which trunk or recipe is best. In the final round I spread bets across good-looking variants. Structurally, the pooling head looks weakest. It pools max, min and mean separately per channel, so it can't easily match each cell's height with whether the target has a cell at the landing layer (the max height under the footprint). That is needed to judge 'fills only target cells and seals no gaps'. A learned convolution with a kernel the size of the footprint sees every footprint cell's features together and can learn these comparisons. Plan: put this footprint-convolution head on (1) the r2c1 trunk and recipe, (2) the 2-epoch, more-samples recipe of r3c1, and (3) a 4-block trunk with the legal-action mask as input. Varying recipe and depth hedges against seed noise and hidden scores.
